nodes.label: ImportColorLdrawImagesJob (planned per-color job)
nodes.rationale: One queued job per color keeps memory bounded and enables parallelism. Each job streams a per-color ZIP from Rebrickable CDN, extracts PNG filenames by stem (matching parts.rebrickable_id), and attaches to a new ldraw media collection on PartColor. Freshness window of 7 days (constant) prevents redundant re-downloads.

nodes.label: LDraw Media Collection Design
nodes.rationale: A new dedicated 'ldraw' media collection (separate from existing 'image' collection) is added to PartColor so future image sources can coexist. Freshness tracked via nullable ldraw_images_imported_at timestamp on colors table.

nodes.label: retrieveZipEntriesFromUrl Contract Extension
nodes.rationale: Extends RebrickableDownloader contract to yield named binary ZIP entries one at a time, keeping memory bounded. A 404 for a missing color ZIP is expected and treated as empty (no error thrown).

nodes.label: LDraw ZIP Download Timeout Fix Plan (quick-island)
nodes.norm_label: ldraw zip download timeout fix plan (quick-island)

nodes.label: Streamed ZIP Download Rationale
nodes.rationale: Http::get() default 30s timeout and full in-memory buffering of response body fails for ~700MB LDraw archives. Fix: use Http sink() to stream bytes directly to a tmpfile, with generous overall timeout (600s default) + short connectTimeout (15s default). Both configurable via config/rebrickable.php env vars.

nodes.label: Chunked Stream-Attach Rationale for ImportColorLdrawImagesJob
nodes.rationale: Buffering all matched PNG bytes for a color into $pngsByStem before attaching uses high memory for large archives. Refactor: process ZIP entries in bounded batches (attachBatchSize=200), resolving part ids with one whereIn per batch and attaching immediately, then clearing the buffer.

nodes.label: Media Conversion Sizing Rationale
nodes.rationale: Three width-based Fit::Contain variants: preview(150x150), medium(350x350), large(500x500). large reduced from 600 to 500 to match actual LDraw render size. 'medium' is new. Conversion names preserved so existing consumers (ProductResource, ProductSearchResource, CartService) need no changes.

nodes.label: Improved Images Import Plan - ldraw_id matching (eager-orchid)
nodes.norm_label: improved images import plan - ldraw_id matching (eager-orchid)

nodes.label: Switch LDraw Image Matching to ldraw_id Rationale
nodes.rationale: Rebrickable per-color LDraw archives name PNG files by LDraw geometry id, not by Rebrickable part id. Matching by rebrickable_id only works where the two ids coincide. Switching to ldraw_id unlocks correct image attachment for all parts. Multiple parts can share an ldraw_id (geometric variants) so the lookup returns a collection.
nodes.norm_label: switch ldraw image matching to ldraw_id rationale

nodes.label: Pre-generate part_colors from Products Rationale
nodes.rationale: part_colors rows only existed when an LDraw render landed on a known part. Pre-generating from products ensures every salable variant gets a render slot. Implemented as INSERT IGNORE ... SELECT from products WHERE productable_type = Part. Also hooked into ImportInventoryJob::handle() for automatic sync on new products.

nodes.label: parts.ldraw_id Schema Addition
nodes.rationale: string(20) nullable, not unique (multiple parts may share an ldraw_id for geometric duplicates), indexed for batch lookups. Populated by extending ImportPartBricklinkNumbersJob to also read external_ids.LDraw from Rebrickable Parts API.

nodes.label: Bricqer-only Image Fallback Rationale
nodes.rationale: For part_colors with no LDraw render, attach Bricqer 'lego-visual' catalog photo into a new dedicated BRICQER_IMAGE_COLLECTION (not the rebrickable_img_url fallback). Split into two passes: 1) URL walk fills parts.bricqer_img_url, 2) per-color attach job downloads bytes only for part_colors lacking LDraw. Display priority: LDRAW > BRICQER > IMAGE.

nodes.label: Bricqer LegoVisual API Integration Design
nodes.rationale: GET /lego-visual/item?part_type=P[&page=N]. ~95k rows, custom pagination (page= param, no page_size). Dedicated request class (not shared PaginatedRequest) to avoid leaking Rebrickable conventions. Case-insensitive bricklink_id match mirrors ImportInventoryJob::upsertProducts(). Self-dispatching job per page with 1s delay.
